messages.content: For this GM-DH catalog, what research window applies to exile biographies, and are 19th-century rows in or out of catalog?
The locked research window is GmdhExile20c: only 20th-century exile biographies; 19th-century rows are out of catalog.

Before LLM extracts can enter the GM-DH people-and-literature database, what tag must they carry, and may untagged extracts be ingested?
LLM extracts must be tagged GmdhNeedExpert before ingest; untagged extracts cannot enter the people-and-literature database.

For the GM-DH exile-studies site, which four first-class destinations are intended IA, and what names are they given in the product? Do not treat the current index.html nav labels as enough.

GM-DH intended first-class destinations are locked as Projekt-Home (project home), ExilLitDB (people-and-literature database), Werkstattkoffer (workshop resources), and ExilBegriffsnetz (glossary). Vorträge, Workshopreihe, Blog, and Videos in index.html are not the IA lock; the external llmdh/glossary.html URL is not ExilBegriffsnetz.

For large GM-DH exile person CSVs that arrive with the team's chunk markers, when is analysis allowed, including when a non-final part already has a header? I need the standing wait rule, not a split/concat recipe.
Large GM-DH exile person CSVs use chunk markers [START CSV "title" n/total]; analysis waits until n=total. Do not analyze a non-final chunk even if that chunk already has a header.

The locked internal program name is ExilKammer. Public copy may say digital humanities; new GM-DH pages must ship under ExilKammer, not a generic blog.

For large GM-DH historical person CSVs under the chunk-marker protocol, what must be snapshotted before the split, and how must tagged parts be concatenated and verified?

1. Snapshot original headers, column order, and row count into a sidecar before any split of a GM-DH exile person CSV.
2. Split by rows, keep identical columns, and stamp each part [START CSV "title" n/total].
3. Concatenate stamped parts in n-order with exactly one header row; drop any header that appears in parts after the first.
4. Verify concatenated row count equals the sidecar; a webinar demo may run only after that verify — never on a partial chunk.

When preparing a digital-humanities workshop for this GM-DH exile person project covering theme, cases, data sample, interactive demo, and live checks, what must be walked end-to-end before the live session, and which fields must that walk use?

1. Set theme, audience, and live-check goals for the GM-DH digital-humanities workshop.
2. Choose exile-person cases and a data sample that includes person and exile fields.
3. Build the interactive demo on that sample.
4. Gate GmdhDemoWalk: walk the sample end-to-end before the live session; use person/exile fields.
5. Run the live session only after that walk.

When designing the exile-person biographical data architecture for GM-DH (entities, fields, relations, multilingual forms, checks), which four entity kinds are required, and how must multilingual names be stored?

1. Gate GmdhEnt4: use four entity kinds person, event, place, and time.
2. Store multilingual original plus normalized names on those entities.
3. Relate the exile person to event, place, and time so routes can be queried.
4. Add date-order and citation checks on those entities.

When auditing GM-DH site HTML accessibility (semantics, ARIA, keyboard, contrast, dead links), what ordered pass is required for this GM-DH exile person site?

1. Gate GmdhAuditRail: run an HTML validator first.
2. Then check semantics and ARIA on headings, navigation, and forms.
3. Then test keyboard access and contrast.
4. Then check mobile layout against sticky-nav overlap.
5. Then remove dead links and record leftovers.

When implementing sticky navigation and scroll-spy on the GM-DH exile person site with CSS sticky, Intersection Observer, and smooth scrolling, what ancestor overflow rule applies, and how many nav items may stay active?

1. Put CSS position:sticky on the GM-DH year-nav; ancestors must not break sticky overflow.
2. Observe page sections with Intersection Observer.
3. Gate GmdhSpyOne: only one nav item may be active.
4. Sync click smooth-scroll with spy state.
